text:
nate_sales: Hey team — quick one. I used the corporate card for airport lounge access ($45) last week because my flight was delayed 4h. Does that fall under reimbursable travel upgrades?

emma_finance: Hi Nate. Can you attach the lounge receipt and the flight delay confirmation? Policy: lounge access on the corporate card is allowed when delay >3h or when booked on a redwood-paid business itinerary. Link: https://intranet.redwood.example/policies/travel.

tanya_ops: I filed the delay from the airline. Delay code: DL-765, original arrival 22:10 -> 02:08 next day. I can paste screenshot in a sec.

nate_sales: Adding files: https://files.redwood.example/receipts/1813509876-lounge.jpg and https://files.redwood.example/itineraries/1813509876-dl765.png

emma_finance: Got receipts. One small thing — charge posted on my personal card though? You said corporate card in the thread. Which card was used?

nate_sales: Sorry typo — used personal card, card ending 4321. I swiped personal because corp-card login failed at the counter.

emma_finance: Thanks for clarifying. Policy allows reimbursement in these cases but need manager signoff for personal-card purchases. @alex_mgr can you confirm this was necessary and approve reimbursement? Also Nate, submit in Ramp as Expense type=Travel->Lounge/Upgrade and attach both receipts.

alex_mgr: Confirming. Flight was delayed for the client demo, Nate needed to stay on-site later. Approving reimbursement to personal card. :white_check_mark:

emma_finance: Great. Nate, submit in Ramp and select reimbursement to bank account (we don't reimburse to card on personal charges). If you want faster, reply with "urgent" and add last 4 digits of account for ACH. Otherwise, expect next payroll cycle. GL code will be 6405.

nate_sales: Submitted RMP-23011 with tags project-zen and client-kairos. Not urgent, next payroll is fine.

ramp-bot: Expense RMP-23011 created and routed to Finance. Processing ETA: next payroll.

emma_finance: I've validated docs; expense approved and queued. Closing thread. :thumbsup:
